paragraphs: The one mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud is found under the entry R' Yehudah, son of R' Shimon ben Pazi.[^1]

notes.text: The pointer includes the entire line-broken target Yehudah son of Shimon ben Pazi, not only Yehudah. בריה דר׳ gives son of R'; no generation is omitted. The notice gives no specific Jerusalem Talmud locator or independently verified identity. All three title components remain R', without importing catalog רבי.
